instruction: A candid photographic still, medium full shot, on a sunny outdoor rooftop. In the center foreground, the woman with short grey hair (R9) in a denim jacket and black skirt leans forward while dancing with arms outstretched, smiling. To her left, the woman in the black beanie and khaki capris (R8) stands dancing with a smile, looking towards the center. In the center background, the woman in the neon green dress (R7) dances with arms raised. On the right, the man in the brown jacket (R10) dances with arms bent, smiling. The scene is lit by warm, direct sunlight under a blue sky.
